name: Violetta
overview: Violetta is a lonely but exceptionally talented teenager who returns to her hometown of Buenos Aires after living many years on the “old continent”. Back home, she will visit Studio 21, a space full of art and music, and will become a frequent visitor. In her new life, she finds true friends and love, as she discovers her innate talent and passion for music and, in turn, builds and faces the great experience of growing up.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Violetta is a teenage girl with a very special talent for singing, something she herself is unaware of. Although her father knows that his daughter is highly gifted in music, he keeps her away from singing and performing. But everything changes when Violetta begins taking piano lessons at the prestigious music school Studio 21. There, she meets new people who will accompany her on her journey of discovering music… and love.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: After discovering that her passion for music is what matters most to her, Violetta must now face new challenges. A new year begins after the summer holidays, and many things have changed at the Studio, now called On Beat. Tomás has returned to live in Spain, and a new boy, Diego, has appeared. He is determined to win Violetta over, regardless of what León thinks.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: After wrapping up their successful European world tour, Violetta and her friends return to Buenos Aires to live their final year at the Studio, where they must face new challenges and obstacles.
